channel.title: GOLFRAW
channel.description: Golf news without the press-release language. Evidence first, opinion labeled.

item.title: Wyndham Clark Gary Woodland BMW Championship: Clark Leads by 5
item.description: Get the Wyndham Clark Gary Woodland BMW Championship recap. Clark shoots 17-under at Bellerive as Woodland's 199 total protects his Tour Championship bubble spot.

item.title: BMW Championship Round 3: Wyndham Clark Leads by 5 at Bellerive
item.description: Get BMW Championship Round 3 scores and odds. Wyndham Clark leads by 5 at 17-under as ShotLink data and East Lake playoff stakes shape Sunday at Bellerive.

item.title: Golf Tournament Rules, Formats, and Tax Guide
item.description: Complete reference for competitive golf tournament formats, USGA handicap allowances, Rule 3.3b scorecard compliance, amateur prize limits, and IRS tax withholding.

item.title: Golf Deals: Save ,176 Annually on Equipment and Rounds
item.description: How golfers can systematically save ,176 per year by optimizing equipment release cycles, golf ball choices, and tee-time booking strategies without sacrificing performance.

item.title: Dustin Johnson heard LIV 2.0 is going well. He missed the meeting.
item.description: Dustin Johnson LIV Golf 2.0 comments came second hand. We trace the missed meeting, unfinished investor deal and proposed 28.6% schedule cut.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler sick at the BMW Championship
item.description: Scottie Scheffler shot 72 on 20 August 2026 and skipped media. No diagnosis exists. What is verified, the back-nine maths, and what the field rules mean.

item.title: Lee Westwood Rory McIlroy LIV Golf comments
item.description: Lee Westwood Rory McIlroy LIV Golf comments, checked against the transcripts. See the 8% top-50 figure and which PGA Tour return routes remain open.

item.title: 2026 FM Championship field: what the LPGA entry
item.description: The 2026 FM Championship field runs 27 to 30 August at TPC Boston. Our purse arithmetic, the entry-list numbers, and the date error in the sponsor's own.

item.title: Bryson DeChambeau LIV Golf one more shot
item.description: Bryson DeChambeau LIV Golf one more shot: the plea landed inside an unclosed investment deal. Our count of the 218.34-point gap and what is still unknown.

item.title: No, 15 LPGA cards are not decided
item.description: The 2026 Wildhorse Ladies Golf Classic runs 21 to 23 August. The Race for the Card arithmetic nobody has published, and what a win in Pendleton is worth.

item.title: Scheffler tees off at 2:33. Full BMW Championship
item.description: All BMW Championship 2026 Round 1 tee times in ET and CDT, with the two-hour window that catches both Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy at Bellerive.

item.title: Do LIV players add value to the PGA Tour?
item.description: Do LIV players add value to the PGA Tour? Compare McIlroy's exact words, a 17.78x TV gap and Koepka's return, then judge the evidence for yourself.

item.title: The LIV Golf vendor lawsuit: a $1.23m claim
item.description: The LIV Golf vendor lawsuit was filed 21 July 2026, four weeks before it broke. Settlement offers as a share of the claim, plus the purse maths nobody ran.

item.title: 20 of 50 out: BMW Championship 2026 Round 1
item.description: BMW Championship 2026 Round 1 tee times in ET and CDT, plus why a no-cut event still ends 40 percent of the field's season on Sunday at Bellerive.

item.title: BMW Championship 2026 Round 1 tee times
item.description: BMW Championship 2026 Round 1 tee times, converted to CDT. All 25 Bellerive pairings in both zones, plus the 11-minute interval maths and when to leave.

item.title: Jon Rahm PGA Tour return 2027: What is confirmed
item.description: Jon Rahm PGA Tour return 2027 remains unconfirmed. We trace the PGA rules, his real DP World Tour deal and the 197-day gap since the window shut.

item.title: Golf PGA Australia in 2026: 135 tour cards
item.description: The PGA TOUR cut its 2026 entry pathways while golf PGA Australia events gained international co-sanctioning. We ran the numbers on both sides of that.

item.title: 1,140 golf PGA Australia queries
item.description: An Australian-tagged file of 1,140 golf PGA Australia rows sends 99.89% of its volume to the US tour. We show the arithmetic and correct a venue error.

item.title: Bellerive is 132 yards longer than it was in 2018
item.description: The BMW Championship 2026 Bellerive setup runs 7,448 yards. We subtracted the 2018 card hole by hole: three holes hold half the added length.

item.title: You Start to Make the Golf Swing More Important
item.description: McIlroy finished 66th of 68 and gave the best explanation of golf's most common trap: when you work on your swing, you stop looking at the target.

item.title: FedEx St. Jude Championship 2026 Prize Money
item.description: Scottie Scheffler won $3.6M with an eight-shot victory at TPC Southwind. Complete 2026 FedEx St. Jude Championship prize money payouts and FedExCup points.

item.title: The Last Man to Win at Bellerive Isn't
item.description: Koepka won the 2018 PGA at Bellerive. He paid $5m to leave LIV and missed the playoffs entirely. Fifty players arrive at a course he owns the memory.

item.title: Bellerive Is a Par 72. The Tour Has Decided
item.description: Detroit spent $16.1m to become a par 70 and gave up three 61s. The Tour has re-parred Bellerive with a pen. The fourth straight par 70, and the longest.

item.title: There Are Six Ways to Win Your Club Championship
item.description: Senior, super senior, flights, gross, net. Most club champions won a division, not the championship. What each one actually means, and who verifies it.

item.title: Fifteen Months Ago He Was Playing NAIA Golf. Today
item.description: Jack Whaley survived a 16-for-11 playoff just to make the bracket at Merion. Jay Leng Jr. was 2-6-2 in college match play.

item.title: He Finished 66th and Called It Encouraging
item.description: McIlroy never broke par at Southwind and finished 66th. He also got exactly what he came for — and the conversations with the Tour's CEO explain why.

item.title: Maverick McNealy Lost His Season in an Airport
item.description: Maverick McNealy lost his season in an airport two years ago, projected 50th when he finished. He's back on the same bubble at the same course, by four.

item.title: Jordan Spieth Made the Playoffs Without a Single
item.description: Jordan Spieth is the only player to reach the FedExCup Playoffs without a top-10 finish this season. What that says about how golf measures a year.

item.title: Jon Rahm Has "Earned" $87.7 Million on LIV
item.description: Rahm tops LIV's earnings list at $87.7m — but $36m of that is bonus, and none of it includes his reported $300m signing fee. What the numbers really show.

item.title: The FedExCup Money Will Be Decided Before
item.description: The ~$100m bonus pool is fully distributed after the BMW Championship. East Lake is a $40m tournament with a trophy attached. What that actually means.

item.title: Three Tour Players, One Diagnosis
item.description: Johnson Wagner wants Brian Harman back on his old putter. It's the third case in a fortnight of the same trap — and Scheffler showed the way out of it.

item.title: The Most Welcoming Golf in America Happens
item.description: No handicap, all abilities welcome, private courses open for the day. Why charity golf tournaments are the easiest way into the game — and how to find one.

item.title: Thursday He Took 33 Putts and Shot 68. Friday
item.description: Scheffler tied the TPC Southwind course record with a 61 and leads by three. The seven-shot swing from Thursday was almost entirely on the greens.

item.title: I've Been Calling It an Investment. It May
item.description: Every outlet reported LIV secured an investor. Fried Egg Golf says it's a line of credit — debt, which is what broke LIV in the first place.

item.title: Collin Morikawa Shot 61 at the Travelers and Still
item.description: Collin Morikawa's 9-under 61 tied his career low and left him one shot out. Hovland beat Scheffler in a Monday playoff. What actually happened, verified.

item.title: Jessica Bang, Australian professional golfer
item.description: Jessica Bang, an 18-year-old Australian golfer in her rookie season on the WPGA Tour of Australasia, has died in Bangkok after suffering a brain.

item.title: Morikawa Shot 61 at the Travelers and Lost by One
item.description: Collin Morikawa's 9-under 61 tied his career low and left him one shot out. Hovland beat Scheffler in a Monday playoff. What actually happened, verified.

item.title: LIV Is Offering Its Players Equity Instead
item.description: The DP World Tour is set to resume LIV fines in 2027, a Ryder Cup year. LIV is paying its players in shares. Both jaws of the vice closed in one fortnight.

item.title: The Last Man Into the Playoffs Hits the First
item.description: Jackson Koivun plays as a single at 8:10 a.m. after Berger's withdrawal. Scheffler and McIlroy go at 9:30. Full round one tee times from TPC Southwind.

item.title: McIlroy Didn't Need to Be in Memphis. He Mentioned
item.description: McIlroy is 12th in the FedExCup and safe either way. He skipped Memphis last year and drew criticism. This time he mentioned talking to the Tour's new CEO.
